title: Public Advertising Boards Of The Public Utility Bureau Of The Municipality Of Greater Shanghai

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. L. Opn No. 703.
Date....29....11.- 29.

(C.I.D.) Office Notes
November 27, 1929.

Public Advertising Boards of the Public Utility
Bureau of the Municipality of Greater Shanghai.

Public advertising boards for the use of merchants
have been erected by the Public Utility Bureau on sites
adjoining or abutting the following points on outlying
Roads.-

1. Great Western Road - in a field opposite the Kuang Hua
University (beyond the railway crossing).
2. Hungjao Road and Fraser Road corner.
3. Hungjao Road and Keswick Road corner.
4. Hungjao Road and Avenue Haig corner
5. Chung Shan Road at Hungjao Road crossing.

In the cases of 1 and 5 there is no encroachment on S.M.C.
land, but the other sites, owing to the absence of boundary
stones, are to me doubtful in this respect. The question,
however, could easily be settled by a P.W.D. representative.

While these boards are primarily for advertising at a fee
by merchants, it is known that similar boards in Woosung and
Nantao areas are occasionally made use of by the Kuomintang
for the purpose of exhibiting propaganda posters, and no
doubt we can look to seeing the sins of the foreigner
enumerated on these new boards ere long.

Jno Robertson
C. D. I.

Officer-in-charge,
Special Branch.

（批：Information）
（批：27/11） （批：Stevens 29/11.）

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事侦缉处登记室
编号 L. Opn No. 703.
日期....29....11.- 29.

（刑事侦缉处）办公室备忘录
1929年11月27日。

大上海市公用局公共广告牌。

大上海市公用局已在毗邻或紧接以下外围道路地点的地块上，竖立了供商人使用的公共广告牌：

1. 大西路（Great Western Road）——光华大学对面的一块空地（越过铁路道口）。
2. 虹桥路（Hungjao Road）与弗雷泽路（Fraser Road）转角处。
3. 虹桥路与凯斯威克路（Keswick Road）转角处。
4. 虹桥路与海格路（Avenue Haig）转角处。
5. 中山路（Chung Shan Road）与虹桥路交叉处。

在第1和第5种情况下，并未侵占工部局土地，但由于缺乏界石，其他几处地点在这方面令我存疑。不过，这一问题可由工务处代表轻易解决。

虽然这些广告牌主要是供商人付费刊登广告之用，但众所周知，吴淞和南市地区的类似广告牌偶尔会被国民党用于张贴宣传海报，毫无疑问，我们不久便会在这些新广告牌上看到列举洋人罪行的内容。

Jno Robertson
刑事侦缉处处长

特别科主管

（批注：情报）
（批注：27/11） （批注：Stevens 29/11.）
（批注：a/D.C.I. 情报 JLF 27:11:29.）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE,
POLITICAL BRANCH, (C.I.D.)
Tel: No. 12060
November 27, 1929
To Intelligence Section,

Information has been
received from a reliable
source that hoardings
have been erected on
Hungjais Road at (1)
the corner of Avenue Haig
and (2) Opposite Mr Indent's
house. Please ascertain
confidentially the parties
responsible for the erection
of these hoardings, the
object for which they have
been put up, and whether
the erection of them has
